items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: Was it near Tom Anderson's? ... In fact, I think it might have been one of Tom, might have been Tom Anderson's. Because in those days, he worked around those places singing

ctx.x: He'd be a good person who likes to see, wouldn't he?

My uncle would be very good because he was associated with quite a good number of these old musicians, especially these old piano players that used to play down on, let's see, I believe it was the, on Ramport Street there. It was an old cabaret called, oh, I just can't remember the name of it right now. Was it near Tom Anderson's?
Yeah, it was around there somewhere.
